WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 6 AS last_period),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gm_pct, count(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT 'sales' AS t, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
       min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, sum(net_amount) AS amt
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), 0, sum(refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'period', count(*), 0, 0, min(period_start_date), max(period_end_date), sum(weeks_in_period), 0 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=6

WITH l AS (
  SELECT cp.category, p.category AS cat_then, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, p.standard_unit_cost, s.store_id,
         f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to AS ver_ok
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT category, cat_then, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_cost,
  sum(CASE WHEN net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(standard_cost - quantity*standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN NOT ver_ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ver_bad,
  sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
  sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines,
  sum(net_amount) sold_net, sum(standard_cost) sold_cost
FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web_store, o.status, f.channel_code, count(*) AS n_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
       min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx,
       sum(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_dispatch,
       min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dmin,
       max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dmax
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05' AND (s.store_id=900 OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26') AS mine,
       (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26') AS control,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=6) AS days

SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, cp.category,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY cp.category
ORDER BY cp.category
